evaluationRule.documentMetric: Physical FILE document id in top K; legacy ROOT-only hits are not physical-file evidence.
evaluationRule.blockMetric: Exact current block id, or expected block inside a same-file hit evidenceBlockIds window, in top K; never mixed across split_group. Exact-only retained as exactBlockRecall.
evaluationRule.sameFileMetric: A returned hit shares expected physical file identity; fail-closed when oracle or response has no FILE identity.
evaluationRule.evidenceWindowMetric: Expected block id is present in a returned hit evidenceBlockIds window from the same physical file.
evaluationRule.historicalIds: Excluded; a different parser split or database snapshot is not a valid A/B oracle.
